description: Compute one metric over cases (or motion rulings), optionally broken down by up to two dimensions and narrowed by filters. describe_dataset lists every metric and dimension and which unit each applies to. Groups of three or fewer cases are suppressed. At most 100 groups, largest first.

case_type.description: Case type code: V01, V04 or V09.

disposition_category.description: How the case ended, e.g. withdrawal or plaintiff_verdict; pending for open cases.

filed_from.description: Filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

filed_to.description: Filed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

firm_juris_number.description: Juris number from search_firms; matches either side's lead firm.

group_by.description: Up to two dimensions to break the metric down by.

injury_kind.description: An alleged injury kind, e.g. fracture.

injury_region.description: An injured body region, e.g. neck.

judge_key.description: Judge key from search_judges; matches the judge who decided the disposition.

mechanism.description: How the crash happened, e.g. rear_end.

metric.description: What to compute; see describe_dataset for each metric.

purpose.description: One sentence on what you are trying to find out. Logged to improve the dataset; never returned.

name: stats

anyOf.description: First disposition date counted, inclusive. Outcome counts here cover only cases closed from closedFrom to closedTo, not all time.

closedFrom.description: For metrics over closed cases, the first disposition date counted, inclusive; the figures are not all-time. Null for metrics over every case.

anyOf.description: Last disposition date counted, inclusive: the dataset as-of date.

closedTo.description: For metrics over closed cases, the last disposition date counted, inclusive: the as-of date. Null for metrics over every case.

groups.description: One entry per group, largest n first.

group.description: The group: each group_by dimension and its value. Empty without group_by.

suppressed.description: Too few cases to show; values are withheld.

cases.description: Distinct cases in the group, after the closure window for windowed metrics. Decides suppression.

group.description: The group: each group_by dimension and its value. Empty without group_by.

suppressed.description: Shown: the group has enough cases.

values.description: The metric's figures for the group, always with n; each metric's entry in describe_dataset says what n counts and what the other keys are.

multiValuedDimensions.description: Dimensions where one case can sit in several groups, so group counts overlap.

names.description: Names of the judges and firms in the groups.

totalGroups.description: Groups before the cap on how many are returned.

truncated.description: True when more groups exist than were returned.

unit.description: What the metric counts: cases, or motion rulings for motion_grant_rate.

title: Case statistics
